Three months of three years are feed exceptions, not recipe output (2026-04, 2026-06, 2024-01): a bake carries them as per-month overrides or accepts a 4-minute fajr error in April 2026, a 9-minute isha error in June 2026, and the undescribed January 2024 deviation.
